headline: Binance Resumes Withdrawals in Phases Following $6 Billion Cyberattack
summary: Binance has begun restoring cryptocurrency withdrawals in phases after a cyberattack resulted in the theft of over $6 billion in digital assets. The FBI blamed North Korea, while Binance pledged $6.34 billion to cover losses.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume, making major security breaches and withdrawal halts critical events for global crypto market liquidity and stability.
